description: Upazila headquarters unions researched in public sources (Banglapedia, Wikipedia, upazila portals), 2026-11-21. Only entries with confidence 'high' (an authoritative source states the union outright) are used by the place loader, through hq_union. Everything else is for human review: found_in_source is what a source wrote, suggested_union our nearest union, never applied automatically.
